column1: # Libya, the General Authority of Awqaf and Dar al-Ifta: awqaf.gov.ly's prayer widget for its 22
# cities and api.ifta.ly for Tripoli (profiles-tested.md, data-maghreb-libya). Checked at each city's
# unit point (lat and lon empty); Africa/Tripoli. Standard Asr.
# - In the west the Fajr printed is also when the fast begins (F+E). East of 18.5° E or south of
#   29.5° N Fajr and Maghrib follow the local adhan instead of this national table (ruling R73: the
#   owner's own adhan times of 27 Sep 2026, checked in MaghrebProofTest and in the two owner rows
#   at the end of this file), earlier than this calendar's Fajr and Maghrib, so there those two
#   columns and the imsak they carry (Im, which now reads the same, moved dawn) are not checked (F,
#   M and Im all "-"); sunrise, Dhuhr, Asr and Isha still are.
# - Every city's imsak (Im) is the widget's emsak from the same two fetches (Fajr − 9 to − 11), added
#   to the city files in the archive as a seventh column.
# - Tripoli's table is read by awqaf-widget, which skips the four Wayback captures that show an
#   earlier day than their own (the page served from its cache: 19 May 2025, 2 Feb 2026, 21 May 2026
#   and 3 Sep 2026, the stale capture that reads a minute early at Maghrib and Isha; see
#   AwqafWidgetFormat). nile/tripoli.txt is checked for its imsak column only: its other columns
#   repeat off-libya-tripoli.txt, and its six lines without an imsak are skipped.
# - Not rows: off-ifta-tripoli.txt and nile/tripoli_all.txt repeat the same days (the latter adds
#   24 Sep 2026 from a copy of the widget); off-darifta-cairo-sep.txt, filed LY-IFTA by its name, is
#   Egypt's Dar al-Ifta for Cairo (its Dhuhr is Cairo's).
# Split: fit on the 21 other cities' two days (25–26 Sep 2026); held out, Tripoli's days from March
# 2025 to October 2026, every season, and its imsak, and the owner's two adhan rows (Benghazi and
# End of eating (audit of 3 Oct 2026, before Ramadan 1448): the owner's two adhan rows (Benghazi, Sabha) are checked as F+E, the
# adhan the fast begins at in the east and south. The national rows there still leave the first column
# out: the end of eating is the 19.5 deg dawn the mosques call, 5-6 min before the national table's Fajr
# (never after it; over the class limit by design, ruling R73).
